situations.headline: Pinewood.AI takeover by Ridgeview-backed Bidco: Feoh support shrinks to 0.06% but deal irrevocables hold ~45%

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Pinewood.AI takeover by Ridgeview-backed Bidco: Feoh support shrinks to 0.06% but deal irrevocables hold ~45% (interest 5, risk 3)

thesis.text: Pinewood.AI is subject to a recommended cash takeover by a Ridgeview Partners-backed vehicle announced 19 August 2026; support remains robust at ~44.6% of shares via irrevocables/letters of intent even as one shareholder (Feoh) has progressively sold down its stake from 3.49% to 0.06%, suggesting deal mechanics are intact but warranting monitoring of further shareholder disposals or competing bids ahead of the offer document and shareholder vote.
